Recluster microglia and remove PVMs/BAMs
```{r}
micro_ge = open_matrix_dir("./hypoad_prepro/hypoad_counts_bpcells_mat/")
cell_meta = readRDS("./hypoad_prepro/cell_metadata_hypoad_post_qc.rds")


cell_meta = cell_meta %>% filter(celltype == "Microglia") %>% filter(is_primary_data)
micro_ge = micro_ge[,rownames(cell_meta)]
get_pcs_from_initial_dataset = function(initial_ge_matrix, n_var_genes = 2000, nthreads = 8, npcs = 30) {
  initial_ge_matrix <- multiply_cols(initial_ge_matrix, 1/Matrix::colSums(initial_ge_matrix))
  initial_ge_matrix <- log1p(initial_ge_matrix * 1e4) # Log transform
  #stats <- matrix_stats(initial_ge_matrix, row_stats="variance", threads = nthreads)
  # Variable Gene Selection Using Seurat VST 
  variable_genes <- Seurat::FindVariableFeatures(initial_ge_matrix, nfeatures = n_var_genes) 
  variable_genes = variable_genes %>% filter(variable == T) 
  variable_genes$gene = rownames(variable_genes)
  variable_genes$standard_deviation = sqrt(variable_genes$variance)
  gene_means <- variable_genes$mean
  gene_std <- variable_genes$standard_deviation
  initial_ge_matrix <- initial_ge_matrix[variable_genes$gene,]
  #write to disk before breaking sparsity via z-score
  preprocessed_ge = initial_ge_matrix %>% write_matrix_dir(tempfile("mat"), overwrite = T)
  #z-score
  preprocessed_ge <- (preprocessed_ge - gene_means) / gene_std
  #calculate 30 PCs 
  svd <- BPCells::svds(preprocessed_ge, k = npcs, threads = nthreads)
  pca <- multiply_cols(svd$v, svd$d)
  rownames(pca) = colnames(preprocessed_ge)
  colnames(pca) = paste("PC_",seq(1,ncol(pca)))
  return(pca)

}
pcs_micro = get_pcs_from_initial_dataset(micro_ge)

#finds pcs after log normalization + z-scoring to get relative variance of gene in relation to distribution of that gene in the dataset
harmony_micro = RunHarmony(pcs_micro,meta_data = cell_meta$batch)
```

Clustering utility functions
```{r}
create_snn_graph_from_pcs <- function(pc_coords, knns_returned = 20, M_index_build_param = 100, ef_index_build_param = 200, ef_index_search_param = 200, distance_metric = "euclidean", n_threads = 8) {
  hnsw_index <- RcppHNSW::hnsw_build(
    X = pc_coords,
    ef = ef_index_build_param,
    M = M_index_build_param,
    distance = distance_metric,
    n_threads = n_threads
  )
  nn_index <- RcppHNSW::hnsw_search(
    X = pc_coords,
    ann = hnsw_index,
    k = knns_returned,
    ef = 200,
    n_threads = n_threads
  )
  
  #convert to snn index
  
  #add cell ids as field
  rownames(nn_index$idx) = rownames(pc_coords)
  rownames(nn_index$dist) = rownames(pc_coords)
  
  #convert to snn graph via knn_to_snn function
  snn_graph = knn_to_snn_graph(nn_index)
  rownames(snn_graph) = rownames(nn_index$idx)
  colnames(snn_graph) = rownames(nn_index$idx)
  return(snn_graph)
}



#adapted from bpcells function
get_leiden_clustering_graph_results_from_igraph_function = function(snn_graph, resolution = .1) {
  #set random seed
  set.seed(1)
  objective_function = c("modularity")
  clustered_graph= igraph::graph_from_adjacency_matrix(snn_graph, weighted = TRUE, diag = FALSE, mode = "lower") 
  
  leiden_communities_found = clustered_graph %>% igraph::cluster_leiden(resolution = resolution, objective_function=objective_function)
  
  #dendro stuff start
  
  
  #dendro stuff end
  leiden_communities_found %>% 
    igraph::membership() %>%
    as.factor()
}

#adapted from bpcells function
subcluster_assignments_and_modularity_score  = function(snn_graph, resolution = .1) {
  #set random seed
  set.seed(1)
  objective_function = c("modularity")
  clustered_graph= igraph::graph_from_adjacency_matrix(snn_graph, weighted = TRUE, diag = FALSE, mode = "lower") 
  
  leiden_communities_found = clustered_graph %>% igraph::cluster_leiden(resolution = resolution, objective_function=objective_function)
  
  modularity_score = leiden_communities_found$quality
  cluster_assignments = leiden_communities_found$membership
  names(cluster_assignments) = leiden_communities_found$names
  
  list(modularity_score = modularity_score, new_assignments = cluster_assignments)
}

subcluster_cells_harmony = function(harmony_pcs, cur_cluster_name, modularity_threshold = .8, leiden_resolution = .1) {
  results_list = list()
  snn_graph = create_snn_graph_from_pcs(harmony_pcs)
  mod_score_and_assignments = subcluster_assignments_and_modularity_score(snn_graph, resolution = leiden_resolution)
  results_list$modularity_score = mod_score_and_assignments$modularity_score
  num_new_clusters = length(mod_score_and_assignments$new_assignments %>% unique())
  if (mod_score_and_assignments$modularity_score > modularity_threshold & num_new_clusters > 1) {
      results_list$successful = T
      results_list$new_assignments = paste0(cur_cluster_name,"-",mod_score_and_assignments$new_assignments)
      names(results_list$new_assignments) = names(mod_score_and_assignments$new_assignments)
      results_list$pcs = harmony_pcs
      results_list$snn_graph = snn_graph
  } else{
    results_list$successful = F
    results_list$new_assignments = NA
  }
  return(results_list)
}

get_lognorm_markers = function(cluster_assignments, non_norm_ge) {
  assignments = cluster_assignments$new_assignments
  non_norm_ge = non_norm_ge[,names(assignments)]
  #log norm
  non_norm_ge = multiply_cols(non_norm_ge, 1/Matrix::colSums(non_norm_ge))
  non_norm_ge <- log1p(non_norm_ge * 1e6) # Log cpm
  
  #get markers
  markers_per_clust = marker_features(mat = non_norm_ge, assignments)
  markers_per_clust = markers_per_clust %>% mutate(l2fc = (foreground_mean - background_mean)/log(2))
  markers_per_clust = markers_per_clust %>% mutate(cpm_expression = 100*(2^foreground_mean - 1))

  markers_per_clust
}

micro_clusters = subcluster_cells_harmony(harmony_pcs = harmony_micro,cur_cluster_name = "microglia", leiden_resolution = .1)



mic_markers = get_lognorm_markers(cluster_assignments = micro_clusters, non_norm_ge = micro_ge)
```

Perform DEG analysis on microglia modeling expression per gene ~ad + age + pmi_hours

```{r}
donor_metadata$age = scale(donor_metadata$age)

rna_and_pmi_info = read_csv("./hypoad_prepro/rna and pmi donor info.csv")
rna_and_pmi_info = rna_and_pmi_info[1:14,]
rna_and_pmi_info$pmi_hours_format= rna_and_pmi_info$pmi_hours_format %>% as.character()
#from stack overflow
rna_and_pmi_info$pmi_hours_decimal = 
sapply(strsplit(rna_and_pmi_info$pmi_hours_format,":"),
  function(x) {
    x <- as.numeric(x)
    x[1]+x[2]/60
    }
)

donor_metadata$pmi_hours = rna_and_pmi_info$pmi_hours_decimal[match(donor_metadata$donor_id, rna_and_pmi_info$cell_meta_id)]
donor_metadata$pmi_hours = scale(donor_metadata$pmi_hours)
#copy donor metadata from table 2 
cell_meta_2= cell_meta_2 %>% mutate(
  ad = case_when(condition %in% c("AD_44","AD") ~ "ad",
                 .default = "ctl")
)
cell_meta_2$pmi_hours = donor_metadata$pmi_hours[match(cell_meta_2$donor_id,donor_metadata$donor_id)]
cell_meta_2$age = donor_metadata$age[match(cell_meta_2$donor_id,donor_metadata$donor_id)]
cell_meta_2$ad = factor(cell_meta_2$ad, levels = c("ctl","ad"))
cell_meta_2 = droplevels(cell_meta_2)
```


Diff exp analysis with dreamlet
```{r}

model_formula = "~ad + age + pmi_hours" %>% as.formula

ge_mat <- hypoad_ge[,cell_meta_2 %>% rownames]
ge_mat <- ge_mat %>% as("dgCMatrix")
sce_obj <- SingleCellExperiment(
  assays  = list(counts = ge_mat),
  colData = cell_meta_2
)

pb <- aggregateToPseudoBulk(
  sce_obj,
  assay      = "counts",
  cluster_id = "celltype",
  sample_id  = "donor_id"
)
processed_assay      <- processAssays(pb, model_formula)
processed_de_results <- dreamlet(processed_assay, model_formula)
ad_results <- topTable(processed_de_results, coef = "adad" , number = Inf) %>%
  as.data.frame()


```


Load mouse 
```{r}
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
mouse_comparisons_of_interest <- c("prolonged_amyloid_contrast_f")
mouse_dreamlet_results <- qs2::qs_read("../shared objs and code/dreamlet_de_results_all_contrasts.qs2")
mouse_dreamlet_results <- mouse_dreamlet_results %>%
  filter(cluster == "microglia" &
           comparison  == "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_f")

library(gprofiler2)
ortholog_df <- gorth(query = mouse_dreamlet_results$gene,
                     source_organism = "mmusculus",
                     target_organism = "hsapiens")
mouse_dreamlet_results$human_gene <- ortholog_df$ortholog_name[match(mouse_dreamlet_results$gene, ortholog_df$input)]

mouse_gene_set_sig_results = mouse_dreamlet_results %>% filter(adj.P.Val < .05) %>% mutate(sign_mouse = sign(logFC)) %>% dplyr::select(sign_mouse, human_gene)

mouse_gene_set_sig_results = mouse_gene_set_sig_results %>% ungroup %>%  dplyr::select(sign_mouse, human_gene) %>% dplyr::rename("ID" = human_gene)

ad_results = ad_results %>% filter(ID %in% mouse_gene_set_sig_results$ID)

ad_results$mouse_sign = mouse_gene_set_sig_results$sign_mouse[match(ad_results$ID, mouse_gene_set_sig_results$ID)]

ad_results = ad_results %>%
  mutate(
    pvalue_one_tailed = ifelse(mouse_sign == sign(logFC), P.Value / 2, 1 - P.Value / 2),
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    adj_p_one_tail = p.adjust(pvalue_one_tailed, method = "BH")
  ) %>% 
  arrange(adj_p_one_tail)


write_csv(ad_results, "microglia hypoad validation results.csv")


sig_human_ad_genes = ad_results$ID
```

Plot these genes using dreamlet normalized values
```{r}
# voom-style normalized log2 CPM matrix for the Microglia assay
micro_elist <- assay(processed_assay, "Microglia")
norm_expr   <- micro_elist$E   # genes x donors

# keep only genes passing the one-tailed, mouse-informed threshold
sig_human_ad_genes <- ad_results %>%
  filter(adj_p_one_tail < .05) %>%
  arrange(adj_p_one_tail) %>%
  pull(ID)

genes_to_plot <- intersect(sig_human_ad_genes, rownames(norm_expr))

donor_ad <- cell_meta_2 %>%
  distinct(donor_id, ad)

plot_df <- norm_expr[genes_to_plot, , drop = FALSE] %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "donor_id", values_to = "log2_cpm") %>%
  left_join(donor_ad, by = "donor_id") %>%
  mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = genes_to_plot))

# facet labels carrying the human effect size + one-tailed FDR
facet_labs <- ad_results %>%
  filter(ID %in% genes_to_plot) %>%
  mutate(lab = ID) %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, lab) %>%
  deframe()
```


```{r}
library(ggsignif)

# --- significance annotations ---
sig_labels <- ad_results %>%
  filter(ID %in% genes_to_plot) %>%
  mutate(
    annotations = case_when(
      adj_p_one_tail < 0.001 ~ "***",
      adj_p_one_tail < 0.01  ~ "**",
      adj_p_one_tail < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE                   ~ ""
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, annotations) %>%
  dplyr::rename(gene = ID) %>%
  mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = genes_to_plot))

star_df <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(ymax   = max(log2_cpm, na.rm = TRUE),
            yrange = diff(range(log2_cpm, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(sig_labels, by = "gene") %>%
  mutate(
    xmin       = 1,
    xmax       = 2,
    y_position = ymax + yrange * 0.08
  )

color_ad_ctl = c("ctl" ="#a1bad4","ad"="#f6b2ba")

# --- plot ---
micro_deg_validation_plots <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = ad, y = log2_cpm, fill = ad)) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(width = .1, size = 2) +
    geom_signif(
      data        = star_df,
      aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax,
          annotations = annotations,
          y_position  = y_position),
      manual      = TRUE,
      textsize    = 5,
      vjust       = .3,
      tip_length  = 0.02,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
  facet_wrap(~ gene, scales = "free_y",
             labeller = labeller(gene = facet_labs), nrow = 2) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(ctl = "Control", ad = "AD")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression(log[2]~"CPM"),
       title = "") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_ad_ctl) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold.italic", size = 10),
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
        axis.text = element_text(face = "bold",color = "black",size = 15),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

ggsave("hypoad-microglia-validation-degs.pdf",
       micro_deg_validation_plots, width = 10, height = 8)
```

```{r}
library(qs2)
```
